single.label: PHX +9.5
single.why: Oklahoma City lost Jalen Williams to a severe leg injury on Sunday, Cason Wallace and Jaylin Williams both left that game early, and the Thunder now play the second night of a back-to-back. They scored only 96 and 108 in their two wins, so a 9.5-point cushion is a lot to ask from a shorthanded, tired offense. Phoenix just hung 131 on Golden State with Devin Booker scoring 43 and only needs to keep it inside double digits.

parlay.why: Dallas shows up in Miami without Dereck Lively, Santi Aldama and Naji Marshall, with Cooper Flagg questionable and Caleb Martin doubtful, so Daniel Gafford is the only rim protector standing between Giannis and the basket. Giannis is averaging 28.3 on an 0-3 Heat team that needs a win badly. On the other end, with Flagg likely out, Kyrie Irving keeps all the usage; he is already scoring 28.5 a night and Miami gave up 118.5 per game last season.
